key_insight: A ResNet50-plus-Random-Forest pipeline can classify orbital TIG weld defects with very high accuracy by combining deep visual feature extraction with a robust tree-based classifier.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical inspection aid for precision welding lines, helping detect defect types early and improve structural reliability with less manual analysis.
method: Extract deep features from weld images using ResNet50
Classify four weld categories with Random Forest
evidence_signal: The study used 3,219 weld images from controlled orbital TIG experiments and reported 98% overall accuracy across normal weld, lack of fusion, overheating, and uneven weld classes.
watch_item: Performance was demonstrated on controlled experimental data, so generalization to different welding setups, cameras, or lighting conditions may need further validation.
paper_title: TIG welding defect detection using ResNet and Random Forest
